hardware: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S (laptop; provisional pending the desktop gfx1151)
candidate: Add Q3_K, IQ2_S and IQ2_XS to GGUF_IQ_DENSE_PREFILL_POLICY. These are W4A16-serviceable but were never expressible under the integer-MMQ contract (a scale per 16 elements puts their residuals at +/-128 and +/-1333, which do not fit int8 under a per-32 scale). W4A16 expands per element and has no such constraint, so switching the default to it made them reachable for the first time.

leaf_measurements.protocol: largest aligned tensor per quant, 512 rows, min-of-5 x 3 reps, against the strict dense GEMV

end_to_end.delta: +17.5%, and faster than the integer-MMQ route ever was (171.86)

why_blocked.reference: candidate production against hipEngine strict, EXECUTION-PROFILES.md section 6

candidate_seven_quant.verdict: FAIL on mean only, 6.1% over the 1e-3 limit

why_blocked.note: Every tail passes with margin and no row breaches the 5e-2 ceiling. This is qualitatively unlike the integer-MMQ route's failure, which was a 3.4x breach of that absolute ceiling. Section 6.1 binds all limits together, so the shipped default is the set that provably passes.
why_blocked.attribution: Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M carries no IQ2_S or IQ2_XS tensors, so the entire mean delta is Q3_K alone: +0.000234 mean for +26 tok/s.

unblock_paths: Re-calibrate the envelope for this scope. The 1e-3 mean limit was frozen on a 2026-08-16 Qwen3.5 cluster8 calibration; a UD-scope floor has never been established, and hipEngine strict itself sits at mean 0.001271 against the llama.cpp teacher.
A task gate showing the mean overage does not affect output quality.

Reduce the per-quant mean cost at source. Each routed quant adds mean roughly independently of format (an int8 path and a 25x more accurate fp16 path landed within 0.00003 of each other), which points at accumulation order rather than operand precision - untested.
how_to_enable: One-line edit: add "gguf_q3_k", "gguf_iq2_s", "gguf_iq2_xs" to the quant tuple in GGUF_IQ_DENSE_PREFILL_POLICY. The kernels are already registered on both HIP backends and covered by tests.
limitations: Q3_K is 18.4% of the remaining prefill GPU time on K_M, so it is the largest single block still on the strict GEMV.
IQ2_S and IQ2_XS appear only in K_S, which has no strict-referenced gate run.
